data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 172.746m at 1 January 2018. During 2018 there was an adverse prior year run-off deviation of GBP 1.5m (strengthening), wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012-2015 years of account relating to Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and legacy Catlin entities. This adverse movement represents approximately 0.87% of opening gross claims outstanding and is described as a run-off deterioration on those closed quota share years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure sourced from Note 6 narrative ('Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') which explicitly states an adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.5m. The note does not explicitly label the GBP 1.5m as 'gross' or 'net' in the sentence, but it is the Movement in prior year's provision note and thus treated as the gross prior year reserve movement per extraction rules. The claim development triangle is available (gross amounts in GBP 000s) and was used to cross-check but the narrative movement was taken as primary.
